Amarnath Yatra Begins with Ceremonial Puja and Preparations Underway

The annual Amarnath Yatra has commenced with Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha performing the 'Pratham Puja' to mark the ceremonial start. Preparations for the pilgrimage, including security measures and logistical arrangements, are being highlighted. The Yatra is also being framed as a symbol of social harmony and a significant spiritual journey for devotees.
